messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: High-rate SELECTs observed against users.email and users.phone columns from service_account analytics-ro using 3 distinct client IPs > threshold. Sampling: 4k rows/min over last 7m :rotating_light:
ana (oncall): seeing it, pulling audit logs now. can someone identify the client_id/app id? :eyes:
mike (seceng): SQL patterns look like paginated reads with different user_id filters. snippet from audit logs:
```sql
SELECT id, email, phone FROM users WHERE id > 12345 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000;
-- repeated with different id ranges and ORDER/LIMIT tweaks
```
leah (infra): one of the IPs resolves to our analytics staging cluster in eu-west-1. i disabled the DB user for analytics-ro and blocked the three IPs at the VPC SGs. command run:
```bash
# revoke DB creds
psql -c "ALTER ROLE analytics_ro NOLOGIN;" postgres://admin@db-prod
# added SG deny rules for 10.8.12.0/24 etc
```
ana (oncall): good containment. @jason can you confirm any scheduled job / recent Jenkins deploy that could explain this?
jason (analytics): no scheduled job that does full exports. i checked our job history — only small report that queries aggregated metrics (no PII). the requests looked like ad-hoc paginated exports. i suspect a rotated service token used by a third-party tool.
ben (privacy): we need immediate scope of affected records. ana - can you run a PII filter query on audit log to get count of distinct user_ids accessed? prioritize emails/phones.
mike (seceng): running quick count now, ~9,400 distinct user_ids touched across the window. likely an attempted incremental export. i exported the audit entries to /tmp/pii-access-177100 for the privacy team.
leah (infra): confirmed KMS key usage for the DB storage — data at rest is encrypted, but these are row-level SELECTs after decryption at DB side. KMS logs show the db-cluster role called the key at normal rate. no anomalous KMS grants.
ana (oncall): for comms: I'll notify CS and legal with initial summary and that we've contained. create incident ticket and link audit dump.
mike (seceng): short-term followups: 1) re-enable analytics_ro only after rotating creds + SSO binding, 2) add per-account export rate alert, 3) add query fingerprinting alert for repeated range reads on PII columns.
ben (privacy): privacy asks: freeze downstream exports for any datasets that referenced the affected user_ids until we finish review. also want list of any third-party integrations that queried user table in last 30d.
jason (analytics): i can produce third-party access list — giving me ~30m.
leah (infra): long-term infra asks: enforce least-priv by role (no broad SELECT on users for analytics role), add column-level masking for emails/phones unless explicitly approved, and require DB audit log enrichment with client app_id and token_id for service accounts.
mike (seceng): also propose RBAC change: create scoped roles like analytics_user_profile_read which excludes raw email/phone, and a separate explicitly approved role for export tasks with MFA + ticketing.
nana (oncall): action list i'm capturing in the incident ticket: containment done, counts logged, privacy freeze, creds rotated, RBAC task, audit enrichment, export alerts, postmortem scheduled EOD. tagging @leah @mike @ben @jason.
leah (infra): ACL change plan: i'll open a PR to DB infra repo with migration to drop SELECT on PII columns from analytics_ro and add new role. scheduled patch window tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
mike (seceng): post-incident analytics: run differential evals to detect if data exfil occurred earlier than this window by looking for similar paginated patterns in past 60 days.
ben (privacy): we'll coordinate external disclosure if we confirm unauthorized export of PII. privacy/legal will draft potential notice templates.
jason (analytics): FYI found a stale token used by a contractor integration (token id tkn_7f8a) that had broad read scope. it didn't rotate with our SSO housekeeping. i've revoked it and am adding it to the incident artefacts.
nana (oncall): thanks team. next check-in in 1h with updated counts and PR links. if anyone finds new activity ping me immediately. :white_check_mark:
